title: Add a note
purpose: Add a note to a signed review: a correction, or what its follow-up came to. For holders of the review capability only.
summary: Add a note to a signed review to correct it or record what the follow-up came to. The note is kept with your name and the time.

tasks.title: Correct a signed review
steps: Write the correction in [[Note]], saying what was wrong and what is right, and select [[Add note]].

tasks.title: Record what the follow-up came to
steps: Write what was done in [[Note]], with the ticket or nonconformance number, and select [[Add note]].

good_to_know: A note cannot be changed or removed once added. Add another note to correct it.
The note is not part of what was signed and does not change the review or its checksum.
If someone else added a note after you opened the review, yours is not saved and your typing is kept. Read the latest notes, then add it again.
Do not enter patient names or identifiers. Refer to a ticket or an account by its number or username.

items.label: Note
items.description: Required. A correction, or what the follow-up came to. At most 4,000 characters. It is shown on the review's page under Notes, oldest first, with your name as it is now and the time it was added.

items.label: Add note
items.description: Adds the note and returns to the review's page. Recorded as a change, listed under Changes as Audit review followed by the review's number.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the review's page without saving.

sections.title: Rules
paragraphs: Any holder of the review capability may add a note to any review, not only the person who signed it. Your access is checked again when you save.
The form remembers how many notes the review had when you opened it. A note added by anyone in the meantime refuses yours, with what you typed kept, so that you read it before adding your own.

sections.title: Who can use this page
paragraphs: Staff with a laboratory role who hold the capability Can review access and audit records. Everyone else is refused.
